stories.title: US CIA, ODNI suffer cybersecurity breach of some unclassified information, source says
summary: The US Central Intelligence Agency and the Office of the Director of National Intelligence recently discovered a cybersecurity breach that exposed some of their unclassified information, according to a person familiar with the matter.
The intrusions affected a network that looks for intelligence insights in public, unclassified material, according to the New York Times, which first reported on the breach.
While it was not clear specifically what unclassified material was compromised, information at other government agencies was also believed to have been exposed in the breach, the Times added.

stories.title: Bollywood union asks Modi to bar Netflix's Pakistani series in India
summary: A prominent Bollywood workers' union has asked Prime Minister ‌Narendra Modi's government to ban the forthcoming Netflix series Jo Bachay Hain Sang Samait Lo in India, while seeking a law prohibiting content from Pakistan from being shown in the country.

India has asked all streaming platforms to stop screening Pakistani shows, many of which enjoy ‌a ⁠huge fan following in the country, and AICWA said Netflix would be in violation of the advisory if it showed the series.

"We have also demanded a strong, permanent law with ​the severest penalties and we appeal to Netflix India and all OTT ​platforms never ⁠to show any Pakistani content in India," AICWA, which says it is the largest union of film workers, said in its letter.

stories.title: Pak-Russian IGC inks Protocol, Programme for Economic Cooperation 2026–2030
summary: Pakistan and Russia have signed a protocol and a five-year Programme for Economic Cooperation 2026–2030 at the 11th Intergovernmental Commission meeting in Moscow.
Read: Pakistan, Russia pledge to deepen security cooperation In transport and logistics, both sides agreed to work towards the early launch of a pilot cargo train to Russia.
It was also agreed that the 12th session of the Pakistan-Russia Intergovernmental Commission would be held in Pakistan in 2027.

stories.title: Trump says he will meet El-Sayed on universal healthcare
summary: Trump described El-Sayed as “a smart guy” and said he had done “a very good job” promoting the idea.
El-Sayed made universal healthcare a central issue in his campaign and sought to appeal directly to Trump by proposing that the plan carry the president’s name.
We can do a lot of great things together.” Trump repeatedly attacked El-Sayed during the campaign, while the Michigan Democrat was a vocal critic of the Trump administration.

stories.title: Israel's Eisenkot clinches first coalition agreement in bid to form government
summary: Israel's Yashar party, led by former military chief Gadi Eisenkot, said on Tuesday it agreed to sign a coalition pact with a right-wing opposition party as it seeks to form a government following last month's election.

Israel's parliament was sworn in on November 10 without a new government, after the election on October 27 stripped Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of his majority but left others with no clear path to power.
But they have potential allies in the parties representing Israel's Arab minority, which ​hold 19 seats and ⁠are aligned with Eisenkot in their vehement opposition to Netanyahu.

stories.title: Zardari, Xi exchange letters, hail first Pakistani astronaut's entry into China's space station
summary: In his letter to President Xi, President Zardari extended felicitations to the government and people of China on the landmark achievement and expressed profound appreciation for selecting Pakistan as the first foreign partner in China’s manned space programme.

President Zardari said the achievement reflects China’s remarkable progress in space science and technology as well as its commitment to international cooperation in the peaceful exploration and use of outer space.

The president said Pakistan takes immense pride in this historic achievement, which stands as another testament to the enduring friendship, mutual trust and close cooperation between the two countries.

stories.title: IHC reserves verdict on live-streaming of £190m case appeal
summary: At the hearing, Safdar requested that Imran and Bushra Bibi be allowed to meet next week.
The case Imran and Bushra Bibi are facing a £190 million graft case linked to the Al-Qadir Trust, a welfare organisation they established in 2018.

He subsequently filed a civil miscellaneous application in the IHC seeking a hearing of his appeals against the accountability court verdict, which convicted him and his wife in the £190 million corruption case.

stories.title: PM Shehbaz orders swift overhaul of NCCIA to combat cybercrime
summary: The prime minister also ordered officials to utilise all available resources to clear the backlog of cybercrime cases.

Earlier this week, the NCCIA investigation exposed the increasingly complex nature of cybercrime, including an alleged online betting and money-laundering network involving transactions worth up to Rs1 trillion.

Before that, on Nov 17, the agency announced the arrest of 130 suspects, including nine women, in operations targeting international fraud networks, illegal call centres, personal data trafficking and online blackmailing.

stories.title: One killed, six injured as under-construction building collapses in Karachi's Baloch Colony
summary: One worker was killed, and six others were injured after a six-storey under-construction building collapsed in Karachi's Baloch Colony near Sharah-e-Faisal on Wednesday, with several others feared trapped under the rubble, a Rescue 1122 spokesperson said.

Read: At least 10 killed as three-storey building collapses in Lahore's Baghbanpura President Asif Ali Zardari expressed grief over the building collapse and directed the Sindh government to expedite rescue operations and ensure immediate medical assistance for the injured.
He directed that the investigation examine construction standards, the building's approved plan, and oversight by the relevant authorities.

stories.title: LHC warns of consequences over alleged illegal detention of Fazlur Rehman
summary: Read: JUI-F moves LHC after Fazlur Rehman stopped from leaving Lahore residence The Punjab Inspector General of police, Lahore Deputy Commissioner and other officials have been named as respondents in the petition.
The same day, party leaders condemned the withdrawal of security from Fazl and his son, Maulana Asad Mahmood, and alleged that police had cordoned off the JUI-F chief’s Islamabad residence.
The petition requested the court to direct the police to lift the alleged siege of Fazlur Rehman's residence.

stories.title: Pakistan wrestling faces Olympic funding crisis as LA 2028 dream fades
summary: Pakistan’s hopes of returning to the Olympic wrestling arena at the 2028 Los Angeles Games are already under threat.
The road to Los Angeles is particularly challenging for Pakistan, where a lack of sustained financial support threatens to undermine a sport that has traditionally delivered international medals.

Inam believes Pakistan can win medals if the two wrestlers receive adequate preparation and international-standard training. “I think if we send them to any Russian state for two to three months of training, we can finish on the podium,” he said.

stories.title: Sooryavanshi says Yuvraj Singh advice inspired record-breaking 204
summary: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi says a half-hour pep talk with his idol Yuvraj Singh helped propel the teenage Indian batting sensation to his record-breaking 204 off 53 balls.
Sooryavanshi smashed his hundred off just 28 deliveries, one ball faster than the previous record held by Australia's Jake Fraser-McGurk.
"I spoke to Yuvi Sir, who is my idol, and listened to him with attention," Sooryavanshi said in an interview released by the Board of Control for Cricket in India on Wednesday.

stories.title: 6 dead after small aircraft crashes off Mississippi coast
summary: Six people aboard a small aircraft were found dead after it crashed off the Mississippi coast, with rescue teams recovering their remains following an hours-long search, the US Coast Guard said on Wednesday.

Divers from the Mississippi Department of Marine Resources located the remains of all six occupants inside the aircraft's fuselage, about 2 miles (3.2 kilometres) northeast of Horn Island, according to a Coast Guard statement.
The operation involved Coast Guard crews, the Mississippi Department of Marine Resources, Harrison County divers, Pascagoula police, the FBI and a US Air Force C-130 aircrew.

stories.title: 'Quite good at slogging' - England revel in new batting talent Donald
summary: Dynamic new England opener Aneurin Donald says he is not great at batting but "quite at slogging" after his blistering 85 against Australia thrust him into the global Twenty20 spotlight.

England's all-Welsh opening partnership of Donald and Phil Salt produced a brutal display of power hitting at the Gold Coast on Tuesday as the visitors won the second of their five-match series by eight wickets.
"I've realised I'm not great at batting, but quite good at slogging," said Donald on the change of technique that has seen him break into the England team.

stories.title: Australia passes law forcing internet platforms to take down harmful content
summary: Australia passed a law requiring internet companies to proactively stamp out harmful content and features or face fines of up to 5% of global revenue, a centrepiece of a campaign to rein in Big Tech decried by free speech advocates.

The Digital Duty of Care will take effect in a year and replaces a patchwork of online codes of conduct with an all-encompassing law which the government says puts the onus on platforms to prioritise the safety of Australians.
Some industry groups had warned the law might encourage platforms to become heavy-handed when deciding what content to take down as they sought to avoid punishment.

stories.title: PSX pares early gains as global sell-off weighs on sentiment
summary: The Pakistan Stock Exchange (PSX) struggled to sustain its early momentum on Wednesday as an initially positive start gave way to selling pressure, with a sharp decline in regional equities and renewed global trade concerns weighing on investor sentiment.
However, the positive momentum proved difficult to sustain as investors remained cautious amid mounting concerns in international markets.

Crude oil prices fell more than 1% on Wednesday, giving up part of the previous session's gains as expectations of a market surplus outweighed concerns over potential shipping disruptions in the Middle East.

stories.title: Pakistan, China agree to fast-track LPG plant, petrol import projects
summary: Energy Minister Ali Pervaiz Malik and Chinese Ambassador Jiang Zaidong on Wednesday agreed to fast-track liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) plant and petrol import projects, the Ministry of Energy said.
"Both sides agreed to fast-track LPG plant and petrol import projects and establish a Joint Commercial Team to turn investment opportunities into concrete projects," the ministry said.

The latest engagement came amid renewed efforts by Pakistan to attract Chinese investment in its petroleum and energy infrastructure, including oil and gas exploration, refinery modernisation, storage facilities and offshore development.

stories.title: Israeli airstrike kills four members of Palestinian family in latest Gaza ceasefire violation
summary: In southern Gaza, a medical source at Nasser Hospital said a girl was moderately wounded after Israeli forces fired toward tents housing displaced Palestinians in the Hamad residential area north of Khan Younis.

Storm threatens lives of 1.76 million Palestinians sheltering in tents: Gaza media office A powerful storm expected to hit the Gaza Strip within days could endanger the lives of 1.76 million displaced Palestinians living in tents, Gaza’s Government Media Office warned Tuesday.

Gaza’s Government Media Office said Tuesday it had documented 6,405 Israeli violations of the ceasefire and reported that 1,690 Palestinians had been killed, 6,120 wounded and 223 detained in those incidents.

stories.title: From Pakistan to space: Zeeshan Ali's remarkable journey in pictures
summary: Pakistani astronaut Zeeshan Ali made history on Wednesday by becoming the first astronaut from Pakistan to reach China's Tiangong space station, opening a new chapter in scientific and technological cooperation between the two countries.
The astronauts aboard the spacecraft include mission commander and spacecraft pilot Tang Hongbo, flight engineer Wu Yi and Pakistan's Ali.

Photo: Reuters Pakistani astronaut Muhammad Zeeshan Ali salutes during a press conference before the Shenzhou-24 spaceflight mission to China's Tiangong space station, at the Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center, near Jiuquan, Gansu province, China, November 24, 2026.

stories.title: PM Shehbaz lauds Musadik Malik's diplomacy at Delhi SCO forum
summary: Background Malik visited New Delhi from November 20 to 22 to lead Pakistan's delegation to the inaugural SCO Civilisational Dialogue Forum.
During the forum, Malik delivered his address in Urdu, highlighting Pakistan's diverse cultural heritage and its historical connections with Central Asia, Persia, Arabia and the wider region.
He also explained that he had chosen to address the civilisational forum in Urdu because he wanted to speak from the heart and reflect Pakistan's cultural identity.

stories.title: Political, military leaders hail Zeeshan Ali's historic space mission, laud Pakistan-China ties
summary: In his letter to President Zardari, the Chinese president congratulated the government and people of Pakistan, astronauts from both countries and their respective space industry teams on the Pakistani astronaut's successful entry into space aboard China's Shenzhou spacecraft.

Dar hails milestone in Pakistan-China partnership Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar also congratulated the people of Pakistan and China on the successful launch of Shenzhou-24, carrying a Pakistani astronaut to the Tiangong space station.

Standing there watching Pakistan’s first astronaut, Zeeshan Ali, prepare to lift off as the first international guest aboard China’s space station was a deeply emotional and historic moment for our entire nation.

stories.title: ATC seeks report on Afridi's whereabouts in Radio Pakistan attack case
summary: The case relates to the attack on and arson at the Radio Pakistan building in Peshawar during violent protests on May 9 and 10, 2023, following the arrest of PTI founder Imran Khan.
It was registered on the complaint of Radio Pakistan, which nominated Afridi, former ministers Taimur Saleem Jhagra, Kamran Bangash and Irfan Saleem, and Aamir Khan Chamkani.

On November 17, PTI leaders Taimur Saleem Jhagra and Kamran Bangash were arrested under Section 3 of the Maintenance of Public Order (MPO) Ordinance, hours after the Peshawar High Court granted them interim pre-arrest bail in the Radio Pakistan attack case.

stories.title: Bloodied but unbowed: Galatasaray's Gul stuns Villa
summary: Galatasaray inflicted Aston Villa's second successive Champions League defeat as blood-soaked Deniz Gul sealed a 1-0 victory in Istanbul on Tuesday.

Gul was left with blood pouring from his face after being kicked in the head by Villa's Nicolas Jackson while the Galatasaray forward was in the process of nodding in the second-half winner at RAMS Park.
Villa won their first three league phase matches but defeats at Barcelona and now Galatasaray have derailed their bid to qualify for the last-16 via a top-eight finish.

stories.title: 'Pakistan has begun its journey beyond the stars': Shenzhou-24 carrying Zeeshan Ali docks at China's space station
summary: Pakistan entered a new era of space exploration on Wednesday as Zeeshan Ali became the country's first astronaut to board China's Tiangong space station, paving the way for greater international cooperation in scientific research.

Standing there watching Pakistan’s first astronaut, Zeeshan Ali, prepare to lift off as the first international guest aboard China’s space station was a deeply emotional and historic moment for our entire nation.
The minister prayed for the successful completion of Ali’s space mission and expressed the hope that Pakistan-China friendship would continue to reach new heights.

stories.title: Speakers call for social media accountability, balanced regulation to curb disinformation
summary: Information Minister Attaullah Tarar said Pakistan had nearly 100 million social media users and around 160 million smartphone users, making the spread of unverified information a major challenge.

He said the shift from traditional to social media had transformed the information landscape, allowing anyone with a smartphone to produce and disseminate content and making verification increasingly difficult.
Memon urged social media platforms to deploy artificial intelligence and other tools to identify harmful content, particularly material inciting violence.

stories.title: ‘The universe has no borders': Pakistan's historic space mission draws global praise
summary: Pakistan's first astronaut mission entered its final stages, with Muhammad Zeeshan Ali set to make history as the country's first astronaut to travel to China's Tiangong space station aboard the Shenzhou-24 spacecraft.
Together, let's go further." Congratulations to Muhammad Zeeshan Ali from Pakistan for becoming the first foreign astronaut to board China's #Tiangong space station!

Pakistan is poised to send an astronaut into space for the first time on Wednesday, when air force pilot Muhammad Zeeshan Ali joins China’s Shenzhou-24 mission to the country’s Tiangong space station.

stories.title: Russia’s Sputnik news agency launches Urdu service
summary: The launch comes amid growing engagement between Islamabad and Moscow in trade, energy and diplomatic affairs, with both countries seeking to broaden their bilateral partnership.

Describing its editorial focus, Sputnik Urdu said the service would offer Urdu-speaking audiences coverage of international affairs, global politics, breaking news and in-depth analysis, connecting them with developments from around the world.
The development comes ahead of Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif's official visit to Russia, as the two countries look to expand cooperation across multiple sectors.
